# Anonymized robots.txt modelled on a typical Indian SaaS startup site (WordPress + careers SPA).
# Note the UTF-8 BOM above, CRLF-free lines, comments, mixed-case keys and one misspelling.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
Disallow: /*?replytocom=
Disallow: /*.pdf$
Disallow: /cart
dissallow: /checkout          # misspelled on purpose (RFC 9309 lets crawlers accept it)
Crawl-delay: 5

User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

# A group for us specifically: careers is fine, the internal admin board is not.
USER-AGENT: india-internship-scraper
Disallow: /careers/internal
Allow: /careers
Disallow: /team/private

Sitemap: https://www.examplelabs.in/sitemap_index.xml
Sitemap: https://www.examplelabs.in/careers-sitemap.xml
